note: Single list of map place categories. 'osm' is a list of alternatives (OR); each alternative is a list of [key, value] tags that must all match (AND). It drives scripts/places/fetch-osm-places.mjs. The keys are what the API accepts and the apps filter on. To add a category: add it here, add an icon and labels in the mobile registry (apps/mobile/lib/features/places/domain/place_category.dart) and in the admin translations, then re-run the importer. See docs/maps/places.md.
